en.title: Ultimate Telegram Media Downloader - How to Use
steps: Open Telegram Web at web.telegram.org/k/ and sign in to your Telegram account.
Click the Extensions icon in Chrome, find Ultimate Telegram Media Downloader, and click the pin icon so it is easy to access.
Open any private or public Telegram channel containing the media you want to download.
Step 3: Open a private or public channel
Click the Ultimate Telegram Downloader button in the Telegram Web toolbar to open the downloader.
In the Scanner tab, click the media-type dropdown to choose what you want to find.
Select an option from the dropdown. Media includes photos and videos, while Files and Stories are available as separate options.
Click Scan for files to start finding the selected items in the channel.
Before downloading, you need to register and start the free trial. The trial shown here allows up to 10 downloads for 1 day.
Click the user icon at the top of the downloader to open the account access screen.
On the Account access screen, click Start free trial to begin registration.
Enter an email address that you can access, then click Start trial.
Step 11: Enter your email and start the trial
A confirmation email will be sent to the email address you entered. Open your email inbox and look for it.
Find the trial confirmation email from Extension Trial and open it.
Click the Confirm email button in the message to activate your free trial.
Once the confirmation page says your free trial is active, you are ready to continue.
Go back to the Telegram Web tab. Your account is now created and your trial is active.
Select the files you want to save, then click the Download button to start downloading them.
Step 17: Select files and start downloading
